map.固定资产（登记/折旧/盘点） 使用指南: Fixed Assets (Registration / Depreciation / Stocktaking) User Guide
map.登记资产信息，自动计算折旧（直线法 / 双倍余额递减法 / 年数总和法），生成折: Register asset information and automatically compute depreciation (straight-line / double declining balance / sum of the years' digits), producing a depreciation schedule and the book value.
map.新购笔记本、打印机等入账时，填入原值、残值、使用年限与折旧方法，自动算每年/每月: When a newly purchased laptop or printer is capitalised, enter the original value, residual value, service life and depreciation method to get the annual and monthly depreciation automatically and produce an archivable depreciation ledger.
map.年末计提折旧时，对全部固定资产批量核算当期折旧，导出清单供财务记账与税务申报。: At year end, batch-compute the current period depreciation for all fixed assets and export the list for bookkeeping and tax filing.
map.车辆、设备盘点时，核对账面原值与累计折旧，结合当前二手残值判断是否减值或报废。: When taking stock of vehicles and equipment, compare the book original value and accumulated depreciation against the current second-hand residual value to decide whether there is an impairment or should be scrapped.
map.：资产：联想笔记本，类别电子设备，原值 6000 元，残值 600 元，使用年限: Asset: a Lenovo laptop, category electronic equipment, original value 6000, residual value 600, service life 5 years, straight-line method. Annual depreciation = (6000-600)/5 = 1080 and monthly depreciation = 90; after 5 years the book residual is exactly 600. With the double declining balance method the first two years depreciate more and later years less.
map.三种折旧方法有什么差别？: What is the difference between the three depreciation methods?
map.直线法每年等额；双倍余额递减法前期多提、后期少提（加速折旧）；年数总和法也是加速: The straight-line method charges the same amount each year; the double declining balance method charges more early and less later (accelerated depreciation); the sum of the years' digits is also accelerated but gentler. Once chosen, an accounting depreciation method cannot be changed arbitrarily, and tax depreciation has its own rules, so follow the Enterprise Income Tax Law and your organisation's financial system. The tool is a calculation demonstration only.

A residual rate that is too low or too high affects the expense each period, so estimate it reasonably against the historical disposal price of similar assets.
